WITH 
-- Users with positive engagement time in the 7-day period (Jan 1-7, 2021)
users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
-- Users with positive engagement time in the 2-day period (Jan 6-7, 2021)
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM users_2day u2 WHERE u2.user_pseudo_id = u7.user_pseudo_id
)

WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
  AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
buyer_products AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_qty
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND p.productQuantity > 0
  AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
  AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(total_qty) AS grand_total_qty
FROM buyer_products
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY grand_total_qty DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Get just the maximum number of days
WITH user_first_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_last_visit AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MAX(date) AS last_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_first_transaction AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, MIN(date) AS first_transaction_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
       UNNEST(hits) AS hit
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_first_transaction_device AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date, deviceCategory
  FROM (
    SELECT fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory AS deviceCategory,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
         UNNEST(hits) AS hit
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
      AND hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
user_last_visit_device AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, date, deviceCategory
  FROM (
    SELECT fullVisitorId, date, device.deviceCategory AS deviceCategory,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date DESC) as rn
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    fv.fullVisitorId,
    fv.first_visit_date,
    lv.last_visit_date,
    ft.first_transaction_date,
    lvd.deviceCategory AS last_visit_device,
    ftd.deviceCategory AS first_transaction_device,
    CASE 
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date IS NULL THEN lv.last_visit_date
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date > lv.last_visit_date THEN ft.first_transaction_date
      ELSE lv.last_visit_date
    END AS last_event_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date IS NULL THEN 'last_visit'
      WHEN ft.first_transaction_date > lv.last_visit_date THEN 'first_transaction'
      ELSE 'last_visit'
    END AS last_event_type
  FROM user_first_visit fv
  JOIN user_last_visit lv ON fv.fullVisitorId = lv.fullVisitorId
  LEFT JOIN user_first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
  LEFT JOIN user_last_visit_device lvd ON fv.fullVisitorId = lvd.fullVisitorId
  LEFT JOIN user_first_transaction_device ftd ON fv.fullVisitorId = ftd.fullVisitorId
),
user_last_event_device AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    first_visit_date,
    last_event_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN last_event_type = 'last_visit' THEN last_visit_device
      WHEN last_event_type = 'first_transaction' THEN first_transaction_device
    END AS last_event_device_category
  FROM user_events
)
SELECT 
  MAX(DATE_DIFF(
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', last_event_date),
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_visit_date),
    DAY
  )) AS max_days
FROM user_last_event_device
WHERE last_event_device_category = 'mobile'

WITH inpatient AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) AS calendar_year,
    AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS avg_inpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY _TABLE_SUFFIX
),
outpatient AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(_TABLE_SUFFIX AS INT64) AS calendar_year,
    AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services) AS avg_outpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY _TABLE_SUFFIX
)
SELECT 
  i.calendar_year,
  i.avg_inpatient_cost,
  o.avg_outpatient_cost
FROM inpatient i
LEFT JOIN outpatient o ON i.calendar_year = o.calendar_year
ORDER BY i.calendar_year

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) as total_persons,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) 
     FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
     INNER JOIN (
         SELECT drug_concept_id
         FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength`
         WHERE ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
         UNION ALL
         SELECT 1331235
     ) related_drugs ON de.drug_concept_id = related_drugs.drug_concept_id
    ) as persons_using,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) - 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) 
     FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
     INNER JOIN (
         SELECT drug_concept_id
         FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength`
         WHERE ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
         UNION ALL
         SELECT 1331235
     ) related_drugs ON de.drug_concept_id = related_drugs.drug_concept_id
    ) as persons_not_using,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`) - 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) 
         FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
         INNER JOIN (
             SELECT drug_concept_id
             FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength`
             WHERE ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
             UNION ALL
             SELECT 1331235
         ) related_drugs ON de.drug_concept_id = related_drugs.drug_concept_id
        ),
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`)
    ) * 100 AS percentage_not_using

SELECT usa_latitude, usa_longitude, iso_time, usa_status
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND track_type = 'main' AND name = 'TEDDY'
ORDER BY iso_time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid, name, iso_time, latitude, longitude, usa_wind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND name = 'LAURA'
),
storm_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    a.rn, a.iso_time, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.usa_wind,
    CASE 
      WHEN b.rn IS NOT NULL THEN 
        ST_DISTANCE(
          ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
          ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
        ) / 1000.0
      ELSE 0
    END as segment_km
  FROM storm_points a
  LEFT JOIN storm_points b
    ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn + 1
)
SELECT 
  iso_time,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  usa_wind,
  SUM(segment_km) OVER (ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as cumulative_km
FROM storm_distances
ORDER BY rn

WITH us_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.date,
    AVG(gs.temp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(gs.max_temp) as avg_max,
    AVG(gs.min_temp) as avg_min
  FROM (SELECT stn, wban, date, temp, max as max_temp, min as min_temp FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023`) gs
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON gs.stn = s.usaf AND gs.wban = s.wban
  WHERE gs.date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'
    AND s.country = 'US'
    AND gs.temp != 9999.9 AND gs.temp IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.max_temp != 9999.9 AND gs.max_temp IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.min_temp != 9999.9 AND gs.min_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY gs.date
),
uk_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.date,
    AVG(gs.temp) as avg_temp,
    AVG(gs.max_temp) as avg_max,
    AVG(gs.min_temp) as avg_min
  FROM (SELECT stn, wban, date, temp, max as max_temp, min as min_temp FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023`) gs
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON gs.stn = s.usaf AND gs.wban = s.wban
  WHERE gs.date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'
    AND s.country = 'UK'
    AND gs.temp != 9999.9 AND gs.temp IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.max_temp != 9999.9 AND gs.max_temp IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.min_temp != 9999.9 AND gs.min_temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY gs.date
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE('2023-10-01'), INTERVAL n DAY) as date
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 30)) as n
)
SELECT 
  ad.date,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(us.avg_max - uk.avg_max, 1), 1) as max_temp_diff,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(us.avg_min - uk.avg_min, 1), 1) as min_temp_diff,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(us.avg_temp - uk.avg_temp, 1), 1) as avg_temp_diff
FROM all_dates ad
LEFT JOIN us_stats us ON ad.date = us.date
LEFT JOIN uk_stats uk ON ad.date = uk.date
ORDER BY ad.date

WITH stations_near_chappaqua AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT usaf, wban, name, lat, lon
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE lat != 0.0 AND lon != 0.0 AND state = 'NY'
    AND ST_DWITHIN(
      ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(CONCAT('POINT(', CAST(lon AS STRING), ' ', CAST(lat AS STRING), ')')),
      ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-73.764 41.197)'),
      32186.88
    )
),
temp_counts AS (
  SELECT stn, COUNT(*) as valid_temp_observations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9
  GROUP BY stn
)
SELECT 
  s.usaf,
  s.wban,
  s.name,
  ROUND(ST_DISTANCE(
    ST_GEOGFROMTEXT(CONCAT('POINT(', CAST(s.lon AS STRING), ' ', CAST(s.lat AS STRING), ')')),
    ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POINT(-73.764 41.197)')
  ) / 1609.344, 2) as distance_miles,
  COALESCE(tc.valid_temp_observations, 0) as valid_temp_observations
FROM stations_near_chappaqua s
LEFT JOIN temp_counts tc ON s.usaf = tc.stn
ORDER BY distance_miles

WITH temps AS (
  SELECT year, mo, da, AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
    AND stn IN ('725030', '744860')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) as complaint_date,
    COUNT(*) as total_daily_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
    AND complaint_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY complaint_date
),
complaints AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) as complaint_date,
    complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
    AND complaint_type IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY complaint_date, complaint_type
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.year, t.mo, t.da, t.avg_temp,
    c.complaint_type,
    c.daily_count,
    dt.total_daily_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.daily_count, dt.total_daily_complaints) * 100 as daily_pct
  FROM temps t
  LEFT JOIN complaints c 
    ON CAST(CONCAT(t.year, '-', t.mo, '-', t.da) AS DATE) = c.complaint_date
  LEFT JOIN daily_totals dt
    ON CAST(CONCAT(t.year, '-', t.mo, '-', t.da) AS DATE) = dt.complaint_date
),
complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, SUM(daily_count) as total_complaints
  FROM joined
  WHERE daily_count IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(daily_count) > 5000
),
corr_data AS (
  SELECT 
    j.complaint_type,
    ct.total_complaints,
    COUNT(j.avg_temp) as total_days,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_count) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_count)) * 1.0 /
    (SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.avg_temp, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2)) * 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.daily_count, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_count), 2)))) as corr_temp_count,
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(j.avg_temp * j.daily_pct) - SUM(j.avg_temp) * SUM(j.daily_pct)) * 1.0 /
    (SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.avg_temp, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.avg_temp), 2)) * 
          (COUNT(*) * SUM(POWER(j.daily_pct, 2)) - POWER(SUM(j.daily_pct), 2)))) as corr_temp_pct
  FROM joined j
  INNER JOIN complaint_totals ct ON j.complaint_type = ct.complaint_type
  WHERE j.daily_count IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY j.complaint_type, ct.total_complaints
)
SELECT complaint_type, total_complaints, total_days, 
       ROUND(corr_temp_count, 4) as corr_temp_count,
       ROUND(corr_temp_pct, 4) as corr_temp_pct
FROM corr_data
WHERE ABS(corr_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY complaint_type

WITH 
counts_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS common_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    COUNTIF(status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Critical')) AS alive_count,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Dead') AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
),
counts_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) AS latin_name,
    ANY_VALUE(spc_common) AS common_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Alive') AS alive_count,
    COUNTIF(status = 'Dead') AS dead_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin)
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(c19.latin_name, c15.latin_name) AS latin_name,
  COALESCE(c19.common_name, c15.common_name) AS common_name,
  COALESCE(c19.total_count, 0) AS total_1995,
  COALESCE(c15.total_count, 0) AS total_2015,
  COALESCE(c19.alive_count, 0) AS alive_1995,
  COALESCE(c15.alive_count, 0) AS alive_2015,
  COALESCE(c19.dead_count, 0) AS dead_1995,
  COALESCE(c15.dead_count, 0) AS dead_2015,
  COALESCE(c15.total_count, 0) - COALESCE(c19.total_count, 0) AS total_growth,
  COALESCE(c15.alive_count, 0) - COALESCE(c19.alive_count, 0) AS alive_growth,
  COALESCE(c15.dead_count, 0) - COALESCE(c19.dead_count, 0) AS dead_growth
FROM counts_1995 c19
FULL OUTER JOIN counts_2015 c15 
  ON c19.latin_name = c15.latin_name
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    t.fare_amount,
    tz.borough as pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2016-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2016-01-08'
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_borough,
    CASE
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.05 THEN 'up to 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount, total_amount) <= 0.25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      ELSE 'more than 25%'
    END as tip_category,
    total_amount
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  tip_category,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)) as proportion
FROM categorized
GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
ORDER BY pickup_borough, tip_category

WITH clay AS (
  SELECT trip_id, departure_time AS clay_departure, stop_sequence AS clay_seq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times`
  WHERE stop_id = 14015
),
sacramento AS (
  SELECT trip_id, arrival_time AS sacramento_arrival, stop_sequence AS sacramento_seq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times`
  WHERE stop_id = 16294
),
matching_trips AS (
  SELECT c.trip_id, c.clay_departure, s.sacramento_arrival, c.clay_seq, s.sacramento_seq
  FROM clay c
  JOIN sacramento s ON c.trip_id = s.trip_id
  WHERE c.clay_seq < s.sacramento_seq
),
trip_info AS (
  SELECT mt.trip_id, mt.clay_departure, mt.sacramento_arrival, t.route_id, t.trip_headsign
  FROM matching_trips mt
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t ON CAST(mt.trip_id AS STRING) = t.trip_id
)
SELECT route_id,
       trip_headsign,
       MIN(clay_departure) AS earliest_departure,
       MAX(sacramento_arrival) AS latest_arrival
FROM trip_info
GROUP BY route_id, trip_headsign
ORDER BY route_id, trip_headsign

-- Let's verify the total count and check the full result
SELECT 
    wb.country as country_name,
    wb.country_code,
    covid.cumulative_confirmed,
    wb.year_2018 as population_2018,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(covid.cumulative_confirmed, wb.year_2018) * 100, 4) as percentage_confirmed
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` covid
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` wb
    ON covid.iso_3166_1_alpha_3 = wb.country_code
WHERE covid.date = DATE('2020-06-30')
    AND covid.aggregation_level = 0
    AND wb.year_2018 > 0
ORDER BY percentage_confirmed DESC

WITH daily_cases AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    state_name,
    confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY date) AS daily_new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE state_name = 'Illinois' AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31'
),
top5_daily AS (
  SELECT date, county, state_name, daily_new_cases,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY daily_new_cases DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_cases
  WHERE daily_new_cases IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY daily_new_cases DESC) <= 5
),
county_freq AS (
  SELECT county, COUNT(*) as appearance_count
  FROM top5_daily
  GROUP BY county
)
SELECT county, appearance_count
FROM county_freq
ORDER BY appearance_count DESC, county ASC
LIMIT 5

-- Full proportional allocation query with rounding
WITH zip_5mi AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'WA'
  AND ST_DISTANCE(zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833)) < 5 * 1609.344
),
tracts AS (
  SELECT geo_id, tract_geom, ST_AREA(tract_geom) AS tract_area
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington`
),
tract_data AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, income_per_capita, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '53%'
),
intersections AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    t.geo_id,
    td.total_pop,
    td.income_per_capita,
    td.median_income,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) AS overlap_area,
    t.tract_area
  FROM zip_5mi z
  JOIN tracts t ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
  JOIN tract_data td ON t.geo_id = td.geo_id
  WHERE ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)) > 0
)

  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(total_pop * (overlap_area / tract_area)), 0) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(income_per_capita * total_pop * (overlap_area / tract_area)),

    AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
    AND end_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
),
variant_counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as num_variants, SUM(AN) as total_AN FROM variants
),
allele_counts AS (
  SELECT SUM(ab.AC) as total_AC 
  FROM variants, UNNEST(variants.alternate_bases) ab
),
gene_symbols AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT vep.SYMBOL) as distinct_genes
  FROM variants, UNNEST(variants.alternate_bases) ab, UNNEST(ab.vep) vep
  WHERE vep.SYMBOL IS NOT NULL AND vep.SYMBOL != ''
),
region_info AS (
  SELECT 55064852 - 55039447 as region_length
)
SELECT 
  vc.num_variants,
  vc.total_AN as total_allele_count,
  ac.total_AC as total_alternate_allele_count,
  gs.distinct_genes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ri.region_length, vc.num_variants) as mutation_density
FROM variant_counts vc, allele_counts ac, gene_symbols gs, region_info ri

-- Calculate the net difference: patients with both KRAS and TP53 mutations minus patients with neither
WITH kras_pass AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
tp53_pass AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
all_paad_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ParticipantBarcode 
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` 
    WHERE Study = 'PAAD'
),
both_mutations AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.ParticipantBarcode) as count_both
    FROM kras_pass k
    INNER JOIN tp53_pass t ON k.ParticipantBarcode = t.ParticipantBarcode
),
no_mutations AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ParticipantBarcode) as count_no_either
    FROM all_paad_patients p
    LEFT JOIN kras_pass k ON p.ParticipantBarcode = k.ParticipantBarcode
    LEFT JOIN tp53_pass t ON p.ParticipantBarcode = t.ParticipantBarcode
    WHERE k.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL AND t.ParticipantBarcode IS NULL
)
SELECT b.count_both, n.count_no_either, b.count_both - n.count_no_either as net_difference
FROM both_mutations b, no_mutations n

  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_synonyms_23` ms ON md.molregno = ms.molregno AND ms.syn_type = 'TRADE_NAME'
),
product_approvals AS (
  SELECT UPPER(p.trade_name) as trade_name_upper, MAX(p.approval_date) as latest_approval
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.products_23` p
  WHERE p.applicant_full_name IN ('SANOFI AVENTIS US LLC', 'SANOFI AVENTIS US INC', 'SANOFI-AVENTIS US LLC', 'SANOFI US SERVICES INC')
  GROUP BY UPPER(p.trade_name)
),
molecule_product_approvals AS (
  SELECT tn.molregno, tn.trade_name, pa.latest_approval
  FROM trade_names tn
  LEFT JOIN product_approvals pa ON UPPER(tn.trade_name) = pa.trade_name_upper
)
SELECT md.molregno, md.pref_name, tn.trade_name, md.first_approval, mpa.latest_approval
FROM molecule_data md
JOIN molecule_product_approvals mpa ON md.molregno = mpa.molregno
JOIN trade_names tn ON md.molregno = tn.molregno AND tn.trade_name = mpa.trade_name
ORDER BY md.pref_name
LIMIT 30

WITH fec_donations AS (
  SELECT 
    c.census_tract_geoid,
    f.transaction_amt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` f
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` c
    ON f.zip_code = c.zip_code
  WHERE f.state = 'NY'
    AND f.transaction_amt > 0
    AND c.census_tract_geoid LIKE '36047%'
),
tract_donations AS (
  SELECT 
    census_tract_geoid,
    AVG(transaction_amt) as avg_donation,
    COUNT(*) as donation_count
  FROM fec_donations
  GROUP BY census_tract_geoid
),
kings_tracts AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
)
SELECT 
  k.geo_id AS census_tract_geoid,
  ROUND(COALESCE(d.avg_donation, 0), 2) AS avg_donation,
  k.median_income
FROM kings_tracts k
LEFT JOIN tract_donations d
  ON k.geo_id = d.census_tract_geoid
ORDER BY k.geo_id
LIMIT 15 OFFSET 746

WITH small_contributions AS (
  SELECT cmte_id, SUM(transaction_amt) as total_small_donations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.individuals_2016`
  WHERE transaction_amt > 0 AND transaction_amt < 200
  GROUP BY cmte_id
  HAVING SUM(transaction_amt) > 0
),
committees_with_candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cc.cmte_id, cc.cand_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_committee_2016` cc
),
qualifying_committees AS (
  SELECT sc.cmte_id, sc.total_small_donations
  FROM small_contributions sc
  INNER JOIN committees_with_candidates cwc ON sc.cmte_id = cwc.cmte_id
),
committee_candidate_counts AS (
  SELECT qc.cmte_id, qc.total_small_donations, COUNT(DISTINCT cwc.cand_id) as num_candidates
  FROM qualifying_committees qc
  JOIN committees_with_candidates cwc ON qc.cmte_id = cwc.cmte_id
  GROUP BY qc.cmte_id, qc.total_small_donations
),
candidate_names AS (
  SELECT cwc.cmte_id, STRING_AGG(cand.cand_name, ',' ORDER BY cand.cand_name) as candidate_names
  FROM committees_with_candidates cwc
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_2016` cand ON cwc.cand_id = cand.cand_id
  WHERE cand.cand_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cwc.cmte_id
),
committee_names AS (
  SELECT cmte_id, cmte_nm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_2016`
)
SELECT 
  cn.cmte_nm as committee_name,
  ccc.num_candidates,
  can.candidate_names,
  ccc.total_small_donations
FROM committee_candidate_counts ccc
LEFT JOIN candidate_names can ON ccc.cmte_id = can.cmte_id
LEFT JOIN committee_names cn ON ccc.cmte_id = cn.cmte_id
ORDER BY ccc.cmte_id

WITH co_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '08'
),
co_bgs AS (
  SELECT geo_id, state_fips_code, blockgroup_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '08'
),
co_banks AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as total_banks
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
overlaps AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, b.geo_id
  FROM co_zips z
  JOIN co_bgs b
  ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)
),
zip_bg_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(DISTINCT geo_id) as num_block_groups
  FROM overlaps
  GROUP BY zip_code
)
SELECT zb.zip_code, SAFE_DIVIDE(cb.total_banks, zb.num_block_groups) as avg_banks_per_bg
FROM zip_bg_counts zb
JOIN co_banks cb ON zb.zip_code = cb.zip_code
ORDER BY avg_banks_per_bg DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH cat_images AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT image_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels`
  WHERE label_name = '/m/01yrx' AND confidence = 1.0
),
images_with_cat_any AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT image_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels`
  WHERE label_name = '/m/01yrx'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i WHERE i.image_id IN (SELECT image_id FROM cat_images)) as cat_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i WHERE i.image_id NOT IN (SELECT image_id FROM images_with_cat_any)) as other_count

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) as distinct_users
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210131'
  AND event_name = 'page_view'
  AND (SELECT MAX(IF(e.key = 'page_location', e.value.string_value, NULL)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) e) = 'https://shop.googlemerchandisestore.com/'

WITH events AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
prep AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS segs,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS n
  FROM events
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    event_timestamp,
    page_title,
    segs[OFFSET(3)] AS seg4,
    segs[OFFSET(4)] AS seg5,
    segs[OFFSET(n-1)] AS last_seg,
    n AS total_segments,
    CASE
      WHEN n >= 5 
           AND (LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
                OR LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(segs[OFFSET(n-1)], r'\+')
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN n >= 5 
           AND (LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(3)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables')
                OR LOWER(REPLACE(segs[OFFSET(4)], '+', ' ')) IN ('accessories', 'apparel', 'brands', 'campus collection', 'drinkware', 'electronics', 'google redesign', 'lifestyle', 'nest', 'new 2015 logo', 'notebooks journals', 'office', 'shop by brand', 'small goods', 'stationery', 'wearables'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(segs[OFFSET(n-1)], r'\+')
      THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE page_title
    END AS display_title
  FROM prep
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    display_title,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM classified
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    display_title,
    rn,
    rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY display_title ORDER BY rn) AS grp
  FROM numbered
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(rn) AS first_rn,
    display_title
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY display_title, grp
)
SELECT 
  '1362228.4966015575' AS user_pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>' ORDER BY first_rn) AS navigation_flow
FROM merged

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    DISTINCT
    ep_int.value.int_value as ga_session_id,
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,
    traffic_source.name as traffic_source_name,
    event_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep_int
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  AND ep_int.key = 'ga_session_id'
),
campaigns AS (
  SELECT 
    ep_int.value.int_value as ga_session_id,
    ep_str.value.string_value as campaign_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep_int,
  UNNEST(event_params) as ep_str
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  AND ep_int.key = 'ga_session_id'
  AND ep_str.key = 'campaign'
),
session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.medium,
    s.source,
    s.traffic_source_name,
    c.campaign_name,
    s.ga_session_id
  FROM sessions s
  LEFT JOIN campaigns c ON s.ga_session_id = c.ga_session_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN campaign_name LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN medium = '(none)' AND source = '(direct)' THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart)$')
        OR (campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign_name), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')))
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch)$')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(display|banner|expandable|interstitial|cpm)$') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'organic') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp)$')
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(social|social-network|social-media|sm|social network|social media)$') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch)$')
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart)$')
        OR (campaign_name IS NOT NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(campaign_name), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail)$') 
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'^(email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail)$') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN LOWER(source) = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'push$') 
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END as channel
  FROM session_data
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) as sessions
FROM classified
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH first_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20180917'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohort_info AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), WEEK(MONDAY)) as cohort_monday
  FROM first_sessions
),
week2_range AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    cohort_monday,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_monday, INTERVAL 14 DAY) as week2_start,
    DATE_ADD(cohort_monday, INTERVAL 20 DAY) as week2_end
  FROM cohort_info
),
week2_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    e.user_pseudo_id,
    wr.cohort_monday
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
  JOIN week2_range wr ON e.user_pseudo_id = wr.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180723' AND '20181007'
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND e.event_date >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', wr.week2_start)
    AND e.event_date <= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', wr.week2_end)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', wr.cohort_monday) as cohort_date,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT ws.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT wr.user_pseudo_id)) as week2_retention_rate
FROM week2_range wr
LEFT JOIN week2_sessions ws 
  ON wr.user_pseudo_id = ws.user_pseudo_id 
  AND wr.cohort_monday = ws.cohort_monday
GROUP BY wr.cohort_monday
ORDER BY wr.cohort_monday

WITH first_open_per_user AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp)) as first_open_ts_utc
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20180930'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_open_ts_utc,
    TIMESTAMP_ADD(first_open_ts_utc, INTERVAL 8 HOUR) as first_open_shanghai
  FROM first_open_per_user
  WHERE DATE(TIMESTAMP_ADD(first_open_ts_utc, INTERVAL 8 HOUR), 'Asia/Shanghai') BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-07'
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.first_open_shanghai,
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
      TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp),
      c.first_open_ts_utc,
      DAY
    ) as day_diff
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20180930'
    AND TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp) > c.first_open_ts_utc
),
retention_flags AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_diff BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week1_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_diff BETWEEN 8 AND 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week2_retained,
    MAX(CASE WHEN day_diff BETWEEN 15 AND 21 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as week3_retained
  FROM user_events
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week1_retained), COUNT(*)), 4) as week_1_retention_rate,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week2_retained), COUNT(*)), 4) as week_2_retention_rate,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(week3_retained), COUNT(*)), 4) as week_3_retention_rate
FROM retention_flags
